title: goes flat after a couple of months
text:
goes flat after a couple of months. Update: I had this pillow now for 3 months and I have to remove some stars and move on to try out the next pillow. It flattened pretty quickly and I kept on fluffing it up to get more support (side sleeper), even at night. I'm now back in pain and I wish I could return it, but this is not the first pillow I bought that was fine for the first weeks and flattened out a couple of months in. I still think the concept with the different zone is decent, but I expect a pillow to last at least 1-2 years for this price.

Original:
I've only had this pillow for a couple of weeks, but I feel that the support is great for the neck and I like that this one can be used for side and back sleepers. I usually do both at night and I had other neck support pillows before and I felt that they always either support side or back sleepers better. This one does both, I only wish the area for the back sleeping would be a bit smaller, since going from side sleeping to back to the other side it a pretty huge distance and you kind of have to push the pillow around. I also like that this one is softer then another brand I tried, which was so hard, that it gave me worse headaches then I had before. So far so good, I hope it keeps its form.
